rows:
يتم تحميل المبرد على 
 Stand
 ووضع خوابير من احدى النهايتين وسد جميع 
 المواسير

اضبط 
 المواسير ماسورة تلو الاخرى وعين وضع التهريب ان وجدت

بعد

المبردات الجديدة

rows:
ركب
 تجهيزة خاصة عبارة عن حامل من القضبان يصل ارتفاعة الى اسفل 
 المبرد بما يعادل 2 بوصة ثم تثبيت القضبان فى فتحات خاصة فى 
 الحائط الحامل للمبردات ويتم وضع مواسير تنزلق عليها المبردات

اسحب 
 المبرد القديم باستخدام كريك حتى يبدء التحميل على المواسير ثم 
 يستكمل سحبه

يتم 
 تحميل المبرد القديم بالونش ووضعه فى مكان امن

ابدأ بتحميل المبرد الجديد 
 ووضعه على المنزلقات ثم على القضبان مع 
 مراعاة محورية رواسمة ومكان تركيبه

ادخل 
 المبرد الجديد باستخدام الكريك

انقل 
 الكمرات الى المبرد المجاور وثبته
 وأخرج المبرد القديم

كرر
 الخطوات السابقة مع باقى المبردات

يتم 
 تركيب الجوانات وخوص التثبيت

اربط 
 وصلات دخول وخروج المياه ثم وضع غطاء المبردات من الناحية 
 الاخرى

يتم 
 ادخاله بالخدمة بعد فتح البلف

This document
outlines the steps for
replacing the generator air coolers, 3 coolers
out of a total of 4 coolers

Safety Precautions

rows: Ensure that the unit on which the generator air coolers are to be replaced is shut down
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories
Provide a safety fence with caution marks around the work area of the equipment
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as the safety helmet, gloves, masks and safety shoes

sections_en.text: Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Occupational safety and health equipment
Open-end wrench set, 19 to 27 mm

Winch, forklift and jack,
and a special fixture for the supports and slides
Wooden wedges, plugs, rubber gaskets, a water hose, and silicone sealant

items: Occupational safety and health equipment
Open-end wrench set, 19 to 27 mm

Winch, forklift and jack,
and a special fixture for the supports and slides
Wooden wedges, plugs, rubber gaskets, a water hose, and silicone sealant

sections_en.text: Work to be Carried Out
Preparations
Shutdown of the generating unit on whose air coolers the work is being carried out
Prepare the supports and slides
Prepare the winch for lowering the air coolers
Remove the cooler water inlet and outlet flanges after closing the valves

Remove the cooler cover,
and test the air coolers to be installed

items: Shutdown of the generating unit on whose air coolers the work is being carried out
Prepare the supports and slides
Prepare the winch for lowering the air coolers
Remove the cooler water inlet and outlet flanges after closing the valves

Remove the cooler cover,
and test the air coolers to be installed

sections_en.text: Testing the Old Coolers

rows:
Place the cooler on a
Stand,
fit wedges at one end and plug all
the tubes
Inspect the tubes one by one and locate any leakage, if present

After testing all the tubes and plugging any leaking tube from both ends,
remove the wedges

sections_en.text: Removal of the Old Coolers and Installation of the New Coolers

rows:
Install a special fixture consisting of a bar support extending to about 2 inches below
the cooler, then fix the bars in special openings in
the wall supporting the coolers, and place pipes on which the coolers slide

Pull out the old cooler with a jack until it rests on the sliding pipes, then
continue pulling it out
Lift the old cooler out with the winch and place it in a safe location
Start moving the new cooler in and place it on the slides and then on the bars, taking into account its axial alignment and installed position
Insert the new cooler using the jack

Move the beams to the adjacent cooler, secure it in place,
and take out the old cooler
Repeat the previous steps with the remaining coolers
Install the gaskets and fixing straps

Reconnect the water inlet and outlet connections, then fit the cooler cover on the other
side
Return it to service after opening the valve
